issues.explanation: No test covers a valid snowflake with surrounding whitespace being trimmed and still mentioned.
CHANGELOG.md was not updated under [Unreleased] despite conventions listing it for doc sync.

conventions.evidence: .env.example:10 DISCORD_MENTION_ID=; config/services.php:65 mention_id env; docs/ops/devops.md:86,89,92 and docs/ops/logging.md:105 document snowflake rules; Pest tests added; no service layer or Livewire/policy changes needed

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43 mentionId() small focused method with PHPDoc; clear names mention/mentionId/limit; consistent mb_* style; no dead code

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:30 '<@'.$mentionId.'>' on "\n".mention; :43-53 trim + preg_match('/^\d{17,20}$/') with int acceptance; :26-36 reserve room limit=MaxContentLength-len-1 and unchanged 1800 path; config/services.php:65 + .env.example:10 + docs/ops/devops.md:89,92 + docs/ops/logging.md:105

scope.evidence: change.diff: 6 files only (.env.example, DiscordOpsAlert.php, services.php, devops.md, logging.md, DiscordOpsAlertTest.php), all directly required by task.md requirements 1-6 and contract

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:47-53 type check is_string/is_int, trim cast, strict /^\d{17,20}$/ silently returns null; rejects '@everyone','@here','abc','123', embedded newlines; digits-only mention prevents injection; no webhook URL logging change

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:24-53 ~30 lines reusing config('services.discord.mention_id') and existing formatContent/safe/MaxContentLength; no new abstractions or duplication

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:117 happy-path own-line assert, :139 integer id, :156 dataset of 10 invalid/empty values asserting no '<@', :183 truncation asserting mb_strlen===1800 with mention; missing valid-with-whitespace trim case and 17/20 boundary cases

review.summary: Adds DISCORD_MENTION_ID -> services.discord.mention_id with strict 17-20 digit validation, own-line <@id> suffix, and truncation that reserves room to keep total at 1800 chars, plus env/docs updates and 4 Pest tests. Requirements, security, and scope are fully met with lean readable code; only nits remain (no trimmed-valid test, no CHANGELOG entry), so approve with nits.
